answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 182418 Country: Pakistan Title: Regarding Aliyan Name Question: We want to give our son this name Aliyan. Answer ID: 182418 Posted on: Oct 6, 2021 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 176/101/SD=2/1443) It is not suitable to keep this name. You should choose any name from the names of Prophets (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon them) and Sahaba (may Allah be pleased with them). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
